title: Window-loop phase transitions
statement: Let $P_t$ and $P_s$ be types with decidable equality, and choose test states $t_e,t_y,t_n\in P_t$ and step states $s_e,s_y,s_n\in P_s$. The phase-dependent transition sends every anchor control to test state $t_e$; in the test phase it sends $t_y$ to the halted stop, $t_n$ to step state $s_e$, and every other control to no successor. In the step phase it sends $s_y$ back to the anchor, $s_n$ to the left stop, and every other control to no successor; all stop controls have no successor.
